reasoning: The pairstyle half is real. FixWallGranKokkos derives from FixWallGranOld (fix_wall_gran_kokkos.h:38), whose constructor accepts 'granular' (fix_wall_gran_old.cpp:83 'else if (strcmp(arg[3],"granular") == 0) pairstyle = GRANULAR;') and whose class enum is 'HOOKE, HOOKE_HISTORY, HERTZ_HISTORY, GRANULAR' (fix_wall_gran_old.h:29). post_force (fix_wall_gran_kokkos.cpp:107-119) is 'if (pairstyle == HOOKE) error->all(...); else if (pairstyle == HOOKE_HISTORY) {...} else if (pairstyle == HERTZ_HISTORY) error->all(...);' with no trailing else, so pairstyle == GRANULAR launches no kernel and raises no error; the fix silently applies zero wall force. Since the style is registered as wall/gran/kk (fix_wall_gran_kokkos.h:16), 'fix ... wall/gran granular ...' under -sf kk hits exactly this path. Note the class-scope enumerators win over the file-local 'enum{HOOKE,HOOKE_HISTORY,HERTZ_HISTORY,BONDED_HISTORY};' at line 24 (member lookup precedes namespace lookup) and both have the same numeric values, so the shadowing enum is only a readability problem, not the cause. ADJUSTMENT: the REGION half is not a KOKKOS port defect -- FixWallGranOld::post_force (fix_wall_gran_old.cpp:645-677) has no REGION branch either (it would leave dx=dy=dz=0, rsq=0 and divide by r=0), so wallstyle 'region' is broken in the base class this port copies; the KOKKOS behaviour (no kernel) is different but the CPU reference is not correct either.
fix: Add a final 'else error->all(FLERR, "Fix wall/gran/kk does not yet support the granular interaction style");' to the pairstyle chain in FixWallGranKokkos::post_force, and an 'else error->all(FLERR, ...)' (or a check in init()) for wallstyle values other than XPLANE/YPLANE/ZPLANE/ZCYLINDER. Better still, reject the unsupported pairstyle/wallstyle in FixWallGranKokkos::init() so the error appears at setup rather than on every timestep. Also rename the file-local enumerator BONDED_HISTORY to GRANULAR (or delete the shadowing enum) so it matches fix_wall_gran_old.h.
